abilities.name: Cypher Use
abilities.description: You can bear one additional cypher at a time.

abilities.name: Idol
abilities.description: At the conclusion of a ten-minute ritual, you create an idol that persists until its magic is exhausted. The idol could be a symbol etched in stone, a figurine woven from twigs, a small carving, or something similar. The idol must be set on a solid surface with a nod toward being protected from the elements, such as being set in a tree hollow, at the base of a wall, or inside a structure.

abilities.name: Bestial Fury
abilities.description: The supplicant is infused with a latent spirit of bestial fury. The fury activates when the supplicant loses their temper or they choose to rouse it as an extra action on their turn.

abilities.name: Healing
abilities.description: The severity of one of the supplicant’s wounds is reduced by one step.

abilities.name: Spiritual Cleanse
abilities.description: The supplicant is freed from one curse, demonic possession, or similar spiritual affliction of level 5 or less.

abilities.name: Effort
abilities.description: You can carry the idol with you.
